WITH member_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_major,
    COUNT(*) as member_count
  FROM member
  GROUP BY link_to_major
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(member_count) as total_members,
    COUNT(*) as num_groups,
    AVG(member_count) as avg_per_group
  FROM member_counts
)
SELECT 
  mc.link_to_major,
  mc.member_count,
  CAST(mc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members as fraction,
  CAST(mc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.avg_per_group as ratio
FROM member_counts mc, totals t
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
